entities.name: Siege of Drannith
entities.description: The 4561 AR battle in which Lukka's monster army attacked Drannith.

entities.name: Lukka
entities.description: A bonder corrupted by the Ozolith who leads a monster army against Drannith and ignites his planeswalker spark.

entities.name: Ozolith
entities.description: An unstable artifact that empowered and corrupted Lukka and exploded during the siege.

entities.name: Drannith
entities.description: The fortified human city of Ikoria.

entities.name: Ikoria
entities.description: The plane of monsters and humans.

entities.name: Leori
entities.description: Person whose death drove Lukka to vengeance.

entities.name: General Kudro
entities.description: Jirina's father, killed by Lukka before the siege.

entities.name: Jirina Kudro
entities.description: General Kudro's daughter, who took command of Drannith's defense and became a colonel.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped defend Drannith and summoned a monstrosaur.

entities.name: Major Humron
entities.description: Officer in the Drannith war council.

entities.name: Yidaro
entities.description: A titanic turtle that Lukka rode.

events.summary: Lukka, vengeful over Leori's death and corrupted by the Ozolith, marches a monster army on Drannith after killing General Kudro.
events.quote: He had earlier killed General Kudro

events.summary: Jirina returns to Drannith, deposes Colonel Bryd and takes command with Vivien and the bonders.
events.quote: assuming de facto command after successfully deposing Colonel Bryd

events.summary: Jirina holds a war council and the First Ring is evacuated; Barrow calls other bonders to help.
events.quote: the First Ring was evacuated to consolidate defenses within the main wall

events.summary: Lukka's army arrives at the northern gate at dawn and breaches the walls, forcing Jirina to deploy the bonders.
Jirina confronts Lukka on Yidaro's shell; he refuses to stop and she leaps to safety as the Ozolith surges.
events.quote: Lukka refused and tried to force more power from the Ozolith.

events.summary: The bonders charge through the gates, rescue Jirina and turn the tide; Vivien summons a monstrosaur to distract Lukka.
events.quote: rescuing Jirina and turning the tide of the battle

events.summary: The Ozolith explodes, severing Lukka from his beasts and igniting his planeswalker spark; he vanishes from Ikoria.
The leaderless monsters scatter; afterwards Jirina becomes colonel and bonded humans and monsters may live in the First Ring.
events.quote: Jirina officially took the rank of colonel.

relations.quote: He had earlier killed General Kudro
the bonded pairs Barrow and Zeph
